title: Alert Dialog
description: A confirmation panel for destructive actions, with an explicit cancel button.
usage: Connect the destructive button to your own action. Cancel, Escape and backdrop clicks dismiss the panel without performing that action.
a11y: Uses native <dialog> with role="alertdialog". Focus cycles inside the open dialog. Close buttons, Escape and backdrop clicks dismiss it and return focus to the opener. IDs and trigger relationships are generated per instance; existing IDs are preserved.
